summary: The claim stands. TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2 randomised 1,736 people with early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease to donanemab or placebo for 76 weeks; donanemab significantly slowed clinical progression on iADRS and CDR-SB, most clearly in people with low or medium tau. No contradicting phase 3 result or retraction was found.

evidence.finding: Registered phase 3 TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2 trial of donanemab in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease; primary endpoint iADRS change at 76 weeks.
Sims et al., JAMA 2023: donanemab slowed clinical progression at 76 weeks versus placebo, with the largest effect in the low/medium tau group.
